findings.message: `datetime.now()` returns a naive local time. If `expires_at` is timezone-aware (as the previous `datetime.now(UTC)` comparison implies), comparing the two raises `TypeError` on every validity check. If it is naive UTC instead, local-time skew makes tokens expire early or live hours longer than intended.
This changes how token expiry is evaluated but adds no test. A test would have caught the naive/aware comparison failure.
